fields.label: Location
fields.note: jr7 RBP-7 (RBP7-05, rippling/widgets.ts): declared a remote search over places, its suggestions the list aria-controls names, else the one shown popper listbox; the suggestion matching the profile's place is chosen, never a free text. Rippling draws the box on the input's wrapper (div.css-1mlcsw inside div[data-testid=<key>], a 1 px border and 16 px padding, 17 px beyond the input's sides), which holds the input and nothing else but decoration: its content box hugs them, so it is the input's box (dom/camouflage.ts drawnByWrapper, core pass Z2 of 2026-11-06; read camouflaged until then). (Location's search icon also sits in that wrapper.)
